messages.question: Frontend Architecture and Design Patterns
messages.answer:
My approach to frontend architecture emphasizes scalability and maintainability. Key aspects include:

  • Atomic Design: Creating reusable components to ensure consistency across the application.
  • Feature-based Design: Organizing code by functionality for easier management and scalability.
  • SOLID Principles: Writing clean, modular, and testable code.
  • Design Patterns: Leveraging patterns like Container-Presenter, Observer, and Factory to enhance code reusability and maintain a clear separation of concerns.
